subscribeRules.seaExport:
Reference no: FCL uses the master B/L no; LCL master/split uses the first container no.
The carrier must have an EDI code, otherwise the shipment cannot be subscribed.
Tracking updates automatically once subscribed.
subscribeRules.seaImport:
Reference no: master B/L no first, otherwise the first container no.
The carrier must have an EDI code, otherwise the shipment cannot be subscribed.
Tracking updates automatically once subscribed.
subscribeRules.airExport:
Reference no comes from the master AWB no and must be 11 digits after removing hyphens.
Shipments already subscribed with an unchanged AWB no reuse the existing subscription.
Tracking updates automatically once subscribed.
